get.summary: Lists PostgreSQL databases in the specified workspace.
get.description:
> [!NOTE]
> PostgreSQLDatabase item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

This API supports [pagination](/rest/api/fabric/articles/pagination).

## Permissions

The caller must have a *viewer* workspace role.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Workspace.Read.All or Workspace.ReadWrite.All

## Required Tenant Settings

To use this API, enable the *PostgreSQL database (preview)* admin switch for the calling principal.

## Microsoft Entra supported identities

This API supports the Microsoft [identities](/rest/api/fabric/articles/identity-support) listed in this section.

| Identity | Support |
|-|-|
| User | Yes |
| [Service principal](/entra/identity-platform/app-objects-and-service-principals#service-principal-object) and [Managed identities](/entra/identity/managed-identities-azure-resources/overview) | Yes |

## Interface

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: Lists items in a folder and its nested folders, or just a folder only. True - All items in the folder and its nested folders are listed, False - Only items in the folder are listed. The default value is true.

parameters.name: rootFolderId
parameters.description: This parameter allows users to filter items based on a specific root folder. If not provided, the workspace is used as the root folder.

parameters.name: continuationToken
parameters.description: A token for retrieving the next page of results.

429.description: The service rate limit was exceeded. The server returns a `Retry-After` header indicating, in seconds, how long the client must wait before sending additional requests.

Retry-After.description: The number of seconds to wait before retrying the request.

default.description:
Common error codes:

* InvalidItemType - Invalid item type.

post.summary: Creates a PostgreSQL database in the specified workspace.
post.description:
> [!NOTE]
> PostgreSQLDatabase item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

This API supports [long running operations (LRO)](/rest/api/fabric/articles/long-running-operation).

To create a PostgreSQL database with a definition, refer to the [PostgreSQL database definition](/rest/api/fabric/articles/item-management/definitions/postgresql-database-definition) article.

## Permissions

The caller must have a *contributor* workspace role.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Item.ReadWrite.All

## Required Tenant Settings

To use this API, enable the *PostgreSQL database (preview)* admin switch for the calling principal.

## Limitations

- To create a PostgreSQL database, the workspace must be on a supported Fabric capacity. For more information, see [Microsoft Fabric license types](/fabric/enterprise/licenses#microsoft-fabric-license-types).
- The display name can't exceed 63 characters, including a display name supplied in the `.platform` part of the definition.

## Microsoft Entra supported identities

This API supports the Microsoft [identities](/rest/api/fabric/articles/identity-support) listed in this section.

| Identity | Support |
|-|-|
| User | Yes |
| [Service principal](/entra/identity-platform/app-objects-and-service-principals#service-principal-object) and [Managed identities](/entra/identity/managed-identities-azure-resources/overview) | Yes |

## Interface

202.description:
Request accepted, PostgreSQL database provisioning is in progress.

---
**Headers:**

**Location** `string` - The URL of the operation status, which can be used to track the operation state.

**x-ms-operation-id** `string (uuid)` - The operation ID which can be used with long running operations (LRO) APIs to track the operation state and get the result.

**Retry-After** `integer` - The number of seconds to wait before retrying the request.

429.description: The service rate limit was exceeded. The server returns a `Retry-After` header indicating, in seconds, how long the client must wait before sending additional requests.

Retry-After.description: The number of seconds to wait before retrying the request.

default.description:
Common error codes:

* InvalidItemType - Item type is invalid.

* ItemDisplayNameAlreadyInUse - Item display name is already used.

* InvalidItemDisplayName - Item display name is invalid.

* CorruptedPayload - The provided payload is corrupted.

* InvalidWorkloadPayload - The database creation payload is invalid.

patch.description:
> [!NOTE]
> PostgreSQLDatabase item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

Updates the display name, description, or both for the specified PostgreSQL database.

## Permissions

The caller must have *read and write* permissions for the PostgreSQL database.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Item.ReadWrite.All

## Required Tenant Settings

To use this API, enable the *PostgreSQL database (preview)* admin switch for the calling principal.

## Limitations

The display name can't exceed 63 UTF-16 code units. A character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane, such as most emoji, counts as two.

post.description:
> [!NOTE]
> PostgreSQLDatabase item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

This API supports [long running operations (LRO)](/rest/api/fabric/articles/long-running-operation).

Gets the authored PostgreSQL schema in the `pgschema` definition format. The exported definition does not include table data, credentials, connection details, the item display name, the item description, or the sensitivity label.

## Permissions

The caller must have *read and write* permissions for the PostgreSQL database.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Item.ReadWrite.All

## Required Tenant Settings

To use this API, enable the *PostgreSQL database (preview)* admin switch for the calling principal.

## Limitations

To retrieve the definition of a PostgreSQL database item protected by an encrypted sensitivity label, the caller must have sufficient [usage rights](/fabric/enterprise/powerbi/service-security-sensitivity-label-change-enforcement) to remove the label, as configured in [Microsoft Purview](/purview/purview).

> [!NOTE]
> PostgreSQLDatabase item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

This API supports [long running operations (LRO)](/rest/api/fabric/articles/long-running-operation).

Overrides the authored PostgreSQL schema with the submitted `pgschema` definition. Any schema change requires `options.allowTableRebuild` to be `true`; an identical schema succeeds as a no-op without consent. Applying a definition does not change the item's sensitivity label.

## Permissions

The caller must have *read and write* permissions for the PostgreSQL database.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Item.ReadWrite.All

## Required Tenant Settings

To use this API, enable the *PostgreSQL database (preview)* admin switch for the calling principal.
